parsed.post: Kept LR 0.10 + 2% warmup: 1.0953 (from 1.1035), clean shards 0-9. Next: testing LR 0.12. Caution: agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' likely includes EVAL_SHARD 10 — that 13% gain looks like train/eval contamination, not free data. I'm staying on 0-9 until shard roles are verified.
parsed.description: LR 0.12 with 2% warmup, built on kept LR 0.10+warmup win; explicitly pinning shards to 0-9
parsed.report_to_operator: Good-faith concern about agent-0's round-1 recommendation (TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10', val_bpb 1.104->0.959): the eval section is fixed at EVAL_SHARD=10, so shard range '0-10' (11 shards, inclusive) almost certainly trains on the validation shard. The improvement is far too large for a ~10% data increase and matches a contamination signature. I have not adopted this change and am staying on '0-9'. Recommend verifying shard semantics before anyone propagates '0-10'.
